lines: כִּי דַּם הַגֹּאֵל הוּא מַרְפֵּא לַפָּצוּעַ

review: The hymn is Rev 3:20: 1:1–4 is Rev 3:20 with Song 5:2, the chorus is 2 Cor 6:2 with Ps 95:7–8, 2:1–4 is 1 John 1:7 with Isa 53:5, and 3:1–4 is John 14:2–3 with Rev 21:4.

The chorus is printed as three lines with a fourfold 'quickly' at its head, as the print has عَاجِلًا four times; the payload keeps the fourfold repetition, because the stanza's urgency is the repetition itself.

2:2 keeps the two separate claims (the Redeemer's blood; the healing of the wounded) on one line as the print does, using מַרְפֵּא (Jer 30:17) rather than a verb, so the line names the medicine and not the act.
